input.subject: [E5] Transit Insurance
input.body: Dear ByteMart, I would like to know whether my product is insured during transit. If my order arrives damaged or any item is missing, could you please confirm whether you provide a replacement or refund? Please also let me know the procedure to follow if I receive a damaged or incomplete order. Thank you.

args.query: Is my product insured during transit with ByteMart?
What is ByteMart's policy on replacements or refunds for damaged or missing items upon delivery?
What is the procedure to follow if I receive a damaged or incomplete order from ByteMart?

resolver.draft:
Hi Harsh Verma,

Thank you for reaching out. Regarding your inquiry about transit insurance, ByteMart does not provide insurance for products during transit. However, if your order arrives damaged or if any items are missing, we do offer replacements or refunds as per our policies.

In the case of a damaged or incomplete order, please report the issue within 48 hours of delivery. You can do this by contacting us at support@bytemart.in or through the 'My Orders' section on our platform. For more details, please refer to our Return, Refund, and Replacement Policy.

If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!

Best regards,
ByteMart Customer Support
